text:
maria: Heads up from support: a customer did a bulk model swap to `redwood-embed-v2` at the same time their system rotated presigned upload URLs. For a short window, embeddings calls returned 401s. Text generation calls unaffected.

chris: Only presigned URLs rotated, no API key change?

maria: Correct. Their batch job updated the model field immediately after rotating URLs; requests included old signed URLs and failed with `401: signature mismatch`. When client fetched fresh presigned URLs and retried embedding calls, they succeeded.

jun: This looks like a migration race between short-lived credentials and model rollout. Docs should warn about stale signed assets during swaps.

chris: Suggest adding a small subsection to the migration checklist: "Short-lived credentials & referenced assets" with these bullets:
- issue new presigned URLs and ensure clients refresh references before swapping models
- invalidate client caches of signed links
- run a quick post-swap smoke test (one user file -> embeddings) per region

maria: I'll draft a simple JS snippet showing the safe pattern (get presigned URL, upload, then call embeddings) and a brief curl example. Also call out retry-on-401 with a fresh presign.

jun: Add note about older SDKs that use optimistic model hints. Recommend sending explicit model names during migration to avoid ambiguous routing. Link back to runtime routing doc.

chris: For SDK migration guide, include a retry/backoff sample: on 401, re-request presigned URL, re-upload, retry embeddings once or with small exponential backoff for ~30s.

maria: Action items:
- maria: open docs PR with new subsection + JS/curl snippets + support case link (EOD)
- chris: add 401 retry example to SDK migration doc
- jun: add one-line note about model-hint header and add runtime doc link

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2301 by maria ":eyes:"

maria: pinging @chris @jun for quick review. I'll also add a short SRE checklist for a one-user post-swap smoke per region.

chris: Good catch. Small copy edits only.

jun: LGTM, will add runtime link.

maria: Closing thread after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
